item.title: Incarico post-doc: Kinetic turbulence and particle acceleration in space plasmas (project (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-17 12:00
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Roma (Zona Tor Vergata)
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

The research activities will be carried out within the framework of the project "REKIPES" (Radial Evolution of large- and KInetic-scale Processes in the Expanding Solar wind). The main objective will focus on the study of intermittency properties in kinetic turbulence, including small-scale reconnection effects, with the kinetic physics of both ions and electrons, primarily using PIC-type codes, such as ZELTRON, already in use within the UNICAL team.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Photonics, Nanotechnologies and Advanced Sensing (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-19 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The research may address one of the following themes: - the development of instrumentation for optical biosensing, including optical interrogation systems, dedicated microfluidic devices and advanced methods for the analysis of spectroscopic data; - the characterization of photonic devices and nanostructures for controlling light-matter interaction, through optical and spectroscopic measurements, electromagnetic modelling of linear and nonlinear responses, and the development of advanced materials; - the multiscale and multimodal characterization of nanostructured materials, including multispectral imaging and terahertz spectroscopy, with the use of machine learning, deep learning and…
